name: sol8-contract-label-clipping
goal: Keep contract provenance labels readable when table columns or viewport widths change

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: 407f1ab711 adds metadata columns, narrowing the clipped example cell; API image 91ddf92f92 cuts Illustrative. Existing code clipped its provenance label together with example data.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Existing catalog checks assert text presence and control fit, but not painted provenance bounds. Extend the shared post-capture contract assertion across all states and viewports without adding cases.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At c46fd364dd, immutable record 73c7e7e92d3b fails the desktop illustrative case on clipped label bounds and retains all three viewport captures.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Move provenance outside the clipped example preview. Retain data ellipsis and exercise the shared glyph-bound guard through the same catalog matrix.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: 15220ee6d4 renders source provenance outside the example ellipsis box. The shared post-capture bounds assertion runs for all three contract components.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged frozen three-viewport command passes at 15220ee6d4; immutable record 24b3739754eb retains all three screenshots.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Isolated committed-source snapshots prove the guard rejects clipped desktop labels at c46fd364dd (73c7e7e92d3b) and accepts the repair at 15220ee6d4 (24b3739754eb).

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
